notes.title: FIND ALL: Bunker - Released!
notes.content:
The continued series of Find All: Bunker games has been released. Explore the underground bunker and the surface of the earth in anticipation of a nuclear explosion, finding various objects and paint the black and white picture with colored paints. 
Also during the release of the game will be released 2 add-ons, in one of which, at the numerous requests of our players we have created coloring.
Extra Level is a large, interesting map for 270 items with an underground bunker and what is left on the surface of the earth after the nuclear explosion. 
Coloring Book. Just print and color the underground bunker before and after the nuclear explosion.
